rules-note: Business strikes only, including the P and D coins the Mint sold only in rolls, bags and boxes: no proofs or reverse proofs, no Special Mint Set, special finish set or other set-only special strikes (Burnished, Enhanced Uncirculated), no silver or bullion strikes. Every coin carries a mint mark (mintMark is never null). variety is the design as displayed in the source, null where one design covers the year; a variety is listed only where the source has a separate row with its own figure, and edge-lettering errors are not varieties. Mintages come only from the saved source, null where it gives no figure; nothing is summed, split or estimated, and totals are ignored. Release order: designs in source order, then the mints. isKeyDate is false throughout because no cited source names key dates; no images. This file: the "Sacagawea dollar" article ("Native American dollar" redirects to it), 2000-2026, P and D each year. variety is null for the Sacagawea reverse (2000-2008) and, from 2009, the year's Native American reverse: the Theme cell of the "Designs by year" table as displayed. Mintages from the "Mintage figures" table (P = Philadelphia, D = Denver); it has no rows after 2022, so the 2023-2026 coins have null mintage. Excluded: the San Francisco proofs, the "Special finish sets" coins (2000-D Burnished, 2014-D, 2015-W, 2016-S, 2017-S, 2019-P Enhanced Uncirculated), the 2000 "Cheerios" and other special strikes (no rows of their own), and the unissued 2027 design.
